title: Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour

description_short: An interactive exhibit that teaches players how Nintendo Switch 2 hardware and features work through demonstrations, quizzes, facts and minigames.

tagline: Get an inside look at the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

gameplayPillars.title: Interactive Exhibit
gameplayPillars.description: Walk across and eventually inside a giant virtual Nintendo Switch 2 while accessing signs, diagrams and demonstrations.

gameplayPillars.title: Tech Demos
gameplayPillars.description: Try experiences designed to show mouse controls, HD Rumble 2 and other hardware features.

gameplayPillars.title: Quizzes and Secrets
gameplayPillars.description: Find hidden facts and answer knowledge questions about the console.

gameplayPillars.title: Minigames
gameplayPillars.description: Compete for high scores and fast times in short hardware-themed challenges.

storyChapters.title: Inside the System

faq.q: Is Welcome Tour free with Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: No. It is sold as separate digital software.
Crowdsourced data lists about 5.5 hours for the main path and roughly 10.5 hours for completionist play.
No. Nintendo lists one player on a single system.
It explains Nintendo Switch 2 design and features such as magnetic Joy-Con 2 attachment, mouse controls, HD Rumble 2 and other hardware technology.
Some demonstrations require additional accessories sold separately.

verdictSummary: A polished interactive hardware tour that succeeds as an educational companion to Switch 2, though its scope is intentionally smaller than a conventional game.
verdictPros: Excellent introduction to Switch 2 hardware concepts
verdictCons: Paid software rather than a bundled system app

reviews.quote: Mixed critical reception; reviewers liked the technical detail but often criticized selling it separately rather than bundling it with the console.
Reviews commonly described it as an interactive manual with surprisingly deep hardware explanations but limited game-like scope.
User aggregate data is notably weaker than many first-party Switch 2 releases.
